001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse;
007
008/**
009 * Written when the pump's bolus permission for a bolus id changes hands. Tandem publishes no name
010 * for opcode 295 (it is absent from the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum and from the Tandem Source
011 * schema), so this class name is provisional.
012 *
013 * <p>Every bolus writes two of these: one when permission is granted (byte 12 nonzero, byte 13 and
014 * the change reason 0) and one when it is released or revoked (byte 12 zero, byte 13 equal to the
015 * first record's byte 12, the change reason nonzero). This holds for BLE, pump-UI and Control-IQ
016 * boluses alike; see https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
017 */
018@HistoryLogProps(
019    opCode = 295,
020    displayName = "Bolus Permission Change"
021)
022public class BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
023
024    private int bolusId;
025    private int unknownU8At12;
026    private int unknownU8At13;
027    private int changeReasonId;
028
029    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog() {}
030
031    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId) {
032        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, unknownU8At13, changeReasonId, 0);
033    }
034
035    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId, int headerHighNibble) {
036        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
037        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, unknownU8At13, changeReasonId, headerHighNibble);
038        this.bolusId = bolusId;
039        this.unknownU8At12 = unknownU8At12;
040        this.unknownU8At13 = unknownU8At13;
041        this.changeReasonId = changeReasonId;
042    }
043
044    public int typeId() {
045        return 295;
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * <table border="1">
050     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog:</caption>
051     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At12</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At13</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>changeReasonId</code></td><td><code>raw[14] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
055     * </table>
056     */
057    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
058        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
059        this.cargo = raw;
060        parseBase(raw);
061        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
062        this.unknownU8At12 = raw[12] & 0xFF;
063        this.unknownU8At13 = raw[13] & 0xFF;
064        this.changeReasonId = raw[14] & 0xFF;
065    }
066
067    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId, int headerHighNibble) {
068        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
069            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(295, headerHighNibble),
070            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
071            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
072            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
073            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At12, (byte) unknownU8At13, (byte) changeReasonId }));
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * @return the bolus id the permission belongs to. It matched the BolusActivated, BolusDelivery
078     * and BolusCompleted ids of the same bolus in every record observed.
079     */
080    public int getBolusId() {
081        return bolusId;
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * @return byte 12. Meaning unconfirmed: it is 1, 2 or 3 on the grant record and 0 on the
086     * release record. Across the observed boluses the value tracked who asked for the bolus:
087     * 1 for a BLE app (BolusDelivery bolusSource 8), 2 for Control-IQ (bolusSource 7) and 3 for
088     * the pump's own UI (bolusSource 1 on t:slim X2, 0 for a Mobi button bolus).
089     */
090    public int getUnknownU8At12() {
091        return unknownU8At12;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * @return byte 13. Meaning unconfirmed: 0 on the grant record; on the release record it equals
096     * byte 12 of the grant record for the same bolus id.
097     */
098    public int getUnknownU8At13() {
099        return unknownU8At13;
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * @return byte 14: 0 on the grant record, then the reason the permission ended. It equals
104     * {@link BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse#getLastChangeReasonId()} for the same bolus id
105     * wherever both were captured (1 = released, 2 = revoked because the pump UI took priority).
106     */
107    public int getChangeReasonId() {
108        return changeReasonId;
109    }
110
111    public BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse.ChangeReason getChangeReason() {
112        return BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse.ChangeReason.fromId(changeReasonId);
113    }
114}
